description: This file defines the CustomerOptionSet entity class used for persistence in the database, mapping to the CUSTOMER_OPTION_SET table. It manages the relationships with CustomerOption and CustomerOptionValue entries, with fields for sorting order and primary key handling.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSet
classes.description: Entity class representing a set of customer options, with mappings to database columns and relationships to CustomerOption and CustomerOptionValue.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the customer option set.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the customer option set.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the primary key (id) of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key (id) of the entity.
